messages.subject: intraspecific variation
parts:
Dear all,

I am currently conducting a morphometric analysis of flowers from five palm species. My objective is to assess the taxonomic boundaries among these species and to analyze the intraspecific variation in their floral structures. Based on my observations, I have identified three levels of variation: species-level differences, individual-level differences, and the positional variation of flowers within the inflorescence (e.g., basal, medial, or apical positions).
I would appreciate any advice on how to quantify the variation explained by each of these levels. This is my first time working with geometric morphometrics, so I am open to any suggestions or recommendations you may have.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Gabriel
